Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODWindow

ShouldShowLinks

The ShouldShowLinks method returns a Boolean value that indicates whether links should be highlighted in this window. 
ODBoolean ShouldShowLinks ();
return value
kODTrue if links should be highlighted in this window, otherwise kODFalse.
SEE ALSO
The ODWindow::SetShouldShowLinks method (page 835).
"Link Borders" on page 381 in OpenDoc Programmer's Guide.
